name: Major cyber incidents
value: Equinor internal IT attack from 17 Nov
summary: Cyberattack on Equinor's internal IT from 17 Nov left staff without email and apps; no restoration date on 19 Nov
state: Equinor detected a cyberattack on its internal IT systems on 17 Nov; production was not affected, but staff lost access to corporate applications and email, and on 19 Nov the company said it had no timetable for full restoration (The Record; Dark Reading). Norwegian utility Skagerak Energi reported an attack on its IT systems on 18 Nov with no effect on operations; no attribution has been made (Dark Reading). Disruption at a large company keeps Watch; no national-scale attack on critical infrastructure was found to 25 Nov.
for_you: Customers of affected firms should watch for phishing that exploits the news. The NCSC publishes guidance for organisations and individuals on protecting accounts and responding to incidents.
rubric_hit: Watch: attack disrupting a large company (Equinor internal IT from 17 Nov); no national-scale critical infrastructure attack

sources.title: The Record — Norway's Equinor hit by cyberattack
Dark Reading — Second Norwegian energy company breached

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
